svg.title: What AI insights would have cost
svg.desc: Running every log through an AI model at $0.003 a call, once a day for 10,000 users, comes to about $11,000 a year. A rule engine running on the device costs nothing at any scale.
svg.text: One log a day each. Every dot is a hundred people.
If every log ran through a model
a year, at ten thousand users
$0.003 a call, once a day, every user, forever
Rule engine, running on the phone
The AI version cost $11,000 a year before it earned a dollar. So it did not ship.
